name: Chain Mail
description: A heavy coat of interlocking rings over a padded gambeson. Loud, hot, and reassuring.

name: Leather Armor
description: Boiled leather, oiled against the rain and quiet on the move.

name: Wayfarer's Brigandine
description: A knee-length coat of ash-dyed canvas lined with small bronze plates, muffled with felt so the wearer does not wake echoes in the deep tunnels.
